name: Creaking Wretch 1
background: CR 2 — animated petrified tree, a trapped soul

inventory.name: Grasping Branch
inventory.desc: Reach 10 ft. Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit. Hit: 9 (2d6+2) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 12) if Medium or smaller.

inventory.name: Splintering Crush
inventory.desc: Only usable against a target the Wretch has grappled. Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit. Hit: 11 (2d6+4) bludgeoning damage.

notes: A petrified tree animated by a soul that never found rest, its bark cracked open in places to reveal a faint, cold light where a face might once have been. It doesn't speak — it only remembers being trapped, and wants company in that grief. Resists bludgeoning/piercing/slashing from nonmagical attacks; immune to necrotic and poison damage; immune to exhaustion and poisoned condition. Darkvision 60 ft. Understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak. Suggested quantity: 2-3 for a 5-6 PC level 3 party.

customFeatures.name: False Stillness
customFeatures.desc: While motionless, a creaking wretch is indistinguishable from a dead, petrified tree. A creature must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom (Perception) check to notice it before it acts.

customFeatures.name: Sunless Dread
customFeatures.desc: Any creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of a creaking wretch must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom save or have disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of its next turn, overwhelmed by grief and cold dread bleeding off the trapped soul.
